<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|400|THE EPISTLE OF S. PAVL|CHA. VIII.}}</noinclude>{{dropinitial|T|image=Rhemes New Testament 1582 initial T, a bird and a human head.png|imgsize=150px|fl={{verse|chapter=8|verse=1}}}}HERE is novv therfore no damnation to them that are in Christ {{sc|Iesvs}}: that walke not according to the flesh. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=2}}† For the lavv of the spirit of life in Christ {{sc|Iesvs}}, hath deliuered me from the lavv of sinne and of death. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=3}}† For that vvhich vvas impossible to the Lavv, in that it vvas vveakened by the flesh: God sending his sonne in the similitude of the flesh of sinne, euen of sinne damned sinne in the flesh, {{verse|chapter=8|verse=4}}† that {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ This conuinceth against the Churches aduersaries, that the law, that is, gods cōmaundemēts may be kept, & that the keeping thereof is iustice, & that in christian men that is fulfilled by Christs grace vvhich by the force of the Law could neuer be fulfilled.}}∷ the iustification of the lavv might be fulfilled in vs, vvho vvalke not according to the flesh, but according to the spirit. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=5}}† For they that are according to the flesh, are affected to the things that are of the flesh, but they that are according to the spirit: are affected to the things that are of the spirit. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=6}}† For the vvisedom of the flesh, is death: but the vvisedom of the spirit, life and peace. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=7}}† Because the vvisedom of the flesh, is {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''`enmitie''.}}`an enemie' to God: for to the law of God it is not subiect, neither can it be. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=8}}† And they that are in the flesh, can not please God. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=9}}† But you are not in the flesh, but in the spirit, yet if the Spirit of God dvvel in you. But if any man haue not the Spirit of Christ, the same is not his. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=10}}† But if Christ be in you: the body in deede is dead because of sinne, but the spirit liueth because of iustification. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=11}}† And if the Spirit of him that raised vp {{sc|Iesvs}} from the dead, dvvel in you: he that raised vp {{sc|Iesvs Christ}} from the dead, shal quicken also your mortal bodies, because of his Spirit dvvelling in you. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=12}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Epistle vpō the 8 Sunday after Pentecost.}}Therfore brethren, vve are detters: not to the flesh, to liue according to the flesh. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=13}}† For if you liue according to the flesh, you shal die. but if by the spirit, you mortifie the deedes of the flesh, you shal liue. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=14}}† For vvhosoeuer {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ He meaneth not that the Childrē of God be violently cōpelled against their willes, but that they be sweetly drawē, moued, or induced to do good. ''Aug. Enchirid. c. 64. De verb. Do. ser. 43 c. 7. et de verb. Apost. ser. 13 c. 11. 12''.}}∷ are ledde by the Spirit of God, they are the sonnes of God. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=15}}† For {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''2. Tim. 1, 7.''}}* you haue not receiued the spirit of seruitude againe in feare: but {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Gal. 4, 5.''}}* you haue receiued the spirit of adoption of sonnes, vvherein vve crie: Abba, (father). {{verse|chapter=8|verse=16}}† For {{sup|‖}} the Spirit him self, giueth testimonie to our spirit, that we are the sonnes of God. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=17}}† And if sonnes, heires also: heires truly of God, and coheires of Christ: ⊣ {{sup|‖}} yet if vve suffer vvith him, that vve may be also glorified vvith him. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=18}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Epistle vpō the 4 Sunday after Pentecost, and for many Martyrs.}}For I thinke that the passions of this time are not {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''condignæ ad gloriam''.}}∷ {{sup|‖}} condigne to the glorie to come that shal be reuealed in vs. {{verse|chapter=8|verse=19}}† For the expectation of the creature, expecteth the reuelation<noinclude>{{rh|||of}}</noinclude>
